bridge_transforms.name: System: Firmware Version Float
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Synthesizes the CoSo firmware float from integer firmware ID 103 divided by 100 when the CAN-backed route cannot satisfy the float path directly.

bridge_transforms.name: System: Random Startup Value
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Masks the raw device startup marker to a 24-bit startup value for MeSoft/CoSo compatibility, preserving reboot-change semantics while avoiding the observed ConvertToNr out-of-range path.
source_evidence: CoSo log: Get INT32 Value ID 115 out of range

bridge_transforms.name: CoSo Flash Status Compatibility
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Returns a neutral saved-to-flash status for CoSo compatibility bulk polling. The CAN-backed route has no numeric TEC v6.31 SDO for this observed CoSo ID, and save execution remains handled by the native SP command path when available.

bridge_transforms.name: System: User Notes
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Treats User Notes as LATIN1 metadata/big-data rather than an INT32 SDO read so CoSo metadata and notes paths receive well-formed read and write responses on CAN-backed routes.

bridge_transforms.name: System: FreeRTOS Statistics
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Treats FreeRTOS Statistics as readonly LATIN1 diagnostics big-data so CoSo metadata and big-data probes receive well-formed empty responses on CAN-backed routes.

bridge_transforms.name: Object External Temperature
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Stores and returns a CoSo compatibility value inside the router for object-external-temperature state that has no TEC v6.31 CANopen numeric SDO object; the default read is NaN until CoSo writes or refreshes the value.
source_evidence: live CoSo trace 2026-05-21 CL25ENG132 metadata ID 52200 failure

bridge_transforms.name: Sink Fixed Temperature
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Stores and returns CoSo sink-fixed-temperature values inside the router for the CAN-backed route. The TEC v6.31 CANopen EDS has no numeric SDO object for this MeCom parameter, but CoSo expects metadata/read/write compatibility for four sink channels.
source_evidence: live CoSo log 2026-05-21 metadata ID 52201 failure

bridge_transforms.name: Status: Temperature Stable
bridge_transforms.bridge_behavior: Returns the conservative non-stable state for CoSo status polling when the CAN-backed route cannot satisfy MeCom ID 1200 directly, avoiding a fatal INT32 miss in mixed ?VX status batches.
source_evidence: live CoSo trace 2026-05-20 ?VX32: ID 1200 instances 1..4 returned -05 over CAN-backed bridge
